compound_provenance: datasets/cbx-social-trends/methodology.md section 3.1 (query CBX liquid) + metadata/queries/query-registry.json (cbx-liquid-ja -> compound_cbx)

coarsening.period: monthly only; weekly output removed from tracked publication candidates
coarsening.shape: marginal breakdowns only, not topic x intent x format x multiple engagement-bin crosses
coarsening.topic_rule: within each month, topic categories with post_count < 5 are merged into other_topic_lt5

re_identifiability.basis: coarse monthly marginal groups; no non-total public cell below 5; no post IDs, author IDs, text, URLs, exact timestamps, or exact engagement counts

evidence_levels: post_count and coarse tiers are derived; month/compound/topic labels are observed group keys; interpretation is out of scope
